OSHA Plusfor organizations that need more depth

Built on the standard program, not a replacement for it

What OSHA Plus addson top of the standard program

Everything in the standard program is included. OSHA Plus exists for organizations whose size, risk profile or payer mix means the baseline is not sufficient — multi-site groups, practices under active scrutiny, and organizations preparing for diligence or accreditation.

Included in addition

  • Annual on-site facility safety walkthrough with photo documentation
  • Live, in-person staff safety training
  • Expanded hazard and risk assessment across all locations
  • Mock OSHA inspection with a prioritised written report
  • Priority inspection response support
  • Equipment and reprocessing documentation review

See the standard program first

Why organizations choose HCP

Why organizations choose HCP

Most vendors sell either software or consulting. The gap between them is where compliance programs fail, so we deliver both under one subscription.

  • A named advisor team, not a ticket queue

    Every client is assigned 3–5 experienced compliance professionals who learn your organization and answer when you call.

  • Audit support is included

    HIPAA, OSHA and payer audit response is covered by your subscription rather than billed as emergency consulting.

  • Customized, maintained documentation

    Policies reflect your specialty, size and state, and are revised when regulations change instead of quietly aging.

  • Three programs, one dashboard

    HIPAA, OSHA and corporate compliance share one login and one completion view — no stitching vendors together.

  • Training people actually finish

    130+ role-based courses with automated assignment and reminders, so completion stops being a chase.

  • Priced for real practices

    Plans scale with headcount. Small practices get the same advisors and audit support as multi-site groups.

Use cases & client outcomes

How organizations use this in practice

Representative engagements drawn from the settings we work in most often.

  • Multi-site group

    Consistency proven across locations

    Challenge: Leadership could not tell whether sites were genuinely operating the same program or just reporting that they were.

    What HCP did: Standardised walkthroughs and expanded assessment ran at every location with identical criteria.

    Result: Real variation identified between sites, with corrective actions tracked to closure.

  • Pre-diligence

    Ready before the reviewers arrived

    Challenge: A platform faced lender review with an undocumented program.

    What HCP did: The expanded package established governance, reporting and audit evidence on a fixed timeline.

    Result: Diligence completed without compliance findings.

  • After a finding

    Closing a citation properly

    Challenge: An organization had abated a citation but had no assurance the underlying gap was fixed everywhere.

    What HCP did: Expanded assessment and mock inspection tested the remediation across the organization.

    Result: Two further instances found and closed before the next inspection cycle.

Outcomes describe representative client engagements. Results vary by organization size, specialty and the state of your existing compliance program.

Questions & common objections

Frequently asked questions

Who is OSHA Plus for?

Organizations whose size, risk profile or payer mix means the standard program is not sufficient — typically multi-site groups, those under active scrutiny, or those preparing for diligence or accreditation.

Does it replace the standard program?

No. Everything in the standard program is included; this adds depth on top of it.

How is it priced?

Pricing depends on headcount, locations and which additions you need. Call (855) 427-0427 and we will scope it against what you actually require rather than sell the whole package by default.

Can we add it mid-term?

Yes, with prorated pricing aligned to your existing renewal date, so you do not wait for a renewal cycle.

Can we start standard and upgrade?

That is the common path. Many clients start with the standard program, then add depth once they can see where their actual gaps are.

Is on-site work included?

Yes — an annual facility walkthrough and live training are part of the package. Additional visits are quoted by scope.
